title: Small Claims Filing Kit (Case Organizer + Worksheets) — $19
description: Organize a small claims case: limit check, damages calculator, evidence and witness logs, demand letter worksheet and court-day checklist. $19.
outcome: Walk into small claims court with your amount calculated, your evidence numbered and a 3-minute summary ready, after checking your state's limit and filing fee.
benefits: Case summary that checks your total against your state's small claims limit
Damages calculator that separates items you can prove from items you can't yet
Evidence log, witness list, timeline, costs and deadline tracker
Demand letter worksheet, hearing outline and court-day checklist (PDF)
50-state reference of limits and filing fees with official source links (40 states fully verified)

files.does: Quick start, demand letter worksheet, hearing outline, court-day checklist, evidence index

steps: Choose your state: the kit shows the claim limit and the published filing fee.
List each amount you are claiming and the proof for it.
Plan and send a demand letter; many disputes end there.
Number your evidence and write your 3-minute summary.
Track filing, service and hearing dates, then pack with the checklist.
forWho: People filing a small claims case without a lawyer
Landlords, tenants, customers and small businesses with a money dispute under the state limit
Defendants who want to organize their side of the story
notFor: Claims above your state's small claims limit (see the 50-state table)
Anyone needing official court forms: get those from your court
Anyone wanting legal advice on whether to sue
compat: Excel 365, LibreOffice Calc 7+ and Google Sheets (File → Import; sheet protection is not carried over). PDFs are US Letter and fillable in Adobe Acrobat Reader and most browser PDF viewers.
limits: It does not provide court forms or file anything for you.
State figures were checked on October 11, 2026; fees change and often vary by county. Ten states are marked "not verified" for at least one figure.
It cannot tell you whether you will win.

faq.a: All 50 states are listed. For 40 states we verified both the small claims limit and the filing fee against official sources; the others are marked "not verified" for the missing figure so you know to ask the clerk.

faq.q: Does it include a demand letter template?
faq.a: It includes a worksheet that helps you plan what to say (facts, amount, deadline). You write the letter in your own words or use a template.
